title: Enforce live stock query permission and scoped inventory evidence
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Existing stock-query users can read inventory only after live enabled user and actual stock-query menu authorization is resolved. Missing identity, disabled/deleted user, revoked menu or unmapped restricted identity fail closed before querying counts, movements or cost fields. Reuse existing role/menu and data-scope services; do not create grants or infer warehouse ownership from customer ids. Where no authoritative scope exists, deny restricted reads of unscoped global stock rather than granting global visibility.

Apply one consistent authorization/scope policy to list, movement evidence, filters and summary before pagination/count/aggregation. No unauthorized count/cost/source-document leakage; request warehouse/source filters cannot broaden scope. Preserve existing response contracts and quantity/valuation semantics for authorized users. Verify privileged and legitimately scoped access, missing identity, revoked permission between requests and denied reads with no mutation, using existing ERP seed records in isolated fixtures.
